records.title: Water purification method
records.description: Describes electrical pretreatment and electrolysis of water followed by activated-carbon treatment. A shaped flow channel aims to reduce uneven passage through carbon. Suitability and water-quality performance require independent testing.

records.title: Heat pump assisted solar heat storage drying equipment
records.description: Combines solar heat collection, heat storage, a heat pump and a drying chamber. Heat recovery and dehumidification could inform produce-drying experiments when sunlight varies.
